panels.title: Request Rate (req/s)
panels.description: Request rate per service, computed from the OTel http.server.request.duration histogram counter. Pivots: select a service in the dropdown to scope. For per-route breakdown see Slowest Endpoints below.

panels.title: Request Latency P50 / P95 (s)
panels.description: Server-side request latency percentiles per service. P95 above 1s sustained is a regression worth tracing — click into Snakk Traces for a span sample, then pivot to Loki via the structured-metadata trace_id.

panels.title: HTTP Status Codes
panels.description: Stacked bars of request rate by HTTP status code across all services in scope. 5xx is hard failure, 4xx is client error; healthy services should be almost entirely 2xx/3xx. Spikes in 5xx during steady load are the canonical regression signal.

panels.title: Slowest Endpoints (P95)
panels.description: Top-10 routes by P95 latency across all services in scope. http_route is the ASP.NET Core route template, so dynamic segments collapse into one entry. Lookup is instant; refresh the dashboard for an updated ranking.

targets.expr: topk(10, histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, service_name, http_route) (rate(http_server_request_duration_seconds_bucket{service_name=~"$service",http_route!=""}[5m]))))

panels.title: Process Memory (MB)
panels.description: Per-service resident process memory from the OTel process instrumentation. Steady upward drift on a service while traffic is flat is a leak — pivot to Snakk Profiles → in-use memory flamegraph.

panels.title: GC Heap (MB)
panels.description: Total managed-heap bytes per service. Saw-tooth pattern is normal (allocation then Gen2 collection). Flat-rising envelope is a managed leak; pair with Snakk Profiles → allocation rate. (Source: prometheus-net dotnet_total_memory_bytes — Phase 6 will migrate to OTel runtime metrics once OpenTelemetry.Instrumentation.Runtime emits them under standard names.)

panels.title: CPU Usage
panels.description: Per-service CPU as fraction of one core. Sustained values near 1.0 indicate a single-threaded hot path; pair with Snakk Profiles → CPU flamegraph for the offending stack.

panels.title: In-Progress HTTP Requests
panels.description: Concurrent in-flight HTTP requests per service from the OTel http.server.active_requests gauge. Climbing curve while request rate is flat = handlers blocking; pivot to Snakk Profiles → lock contention flamegraph.

panels.title: GC Collections Rate
panels.description: Garbage collections per second by generation. Frequent Gen2 collections (top series) signal pressure from large object allocations; pair with the GC Heap panel and Snakk Profiles → allocation rate. (Source: prometheus-net dotnet_collection_count_total — Phase 6 will migrate to OTel runtime metrics once available under standard names.)
